name: Payment Ledger & Reconciliation Platform
description: Payment ledger and reconciliation platform is an enterprise-grade financial infrastructure application and distributed systems blueprint designed for mission-critical payment workflows. It solves the hardest challenges in modern fintech—eliminating dual-write state divergence, preventing concurrent double-spending, maintaining immutable balanced books (∑ Debits ≡ ∑ Credits), and automating multi-source 3-way settlement reconciliation.
